tool.name: Bandage Info
tool.description: Extracts statistics from a GFA assembly graph using Bandage
tool.help:
# Bandage Info
Bandage is a tool for visualizing and analyzing assembly graphs. This tool extracts basic statistics from a GFA file.
## Input
- **Input GFA file**: The assembly graph in GFA format.
## Output
- **Output HTML**: A file containing various statistics about the graph, including node and edge counts, total length, dead ends, connected components, and more.
## Example Output
``` Node count: 561 Edge count: 734 Total length (bp): 4878380 Dead ends: 33 Percentage dead ends: 2.94118% Connected components: 19 Largest component (bp): 4821329 N50 (bp): 90360 Shortest node (bp): 1 Lower quartile node (bp): 17 Median node (bp): 87 Upper quartile node (bp): 404 Longest node (bp): 205425 ```
